description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating speech recognition, text-to-speech, language model, and custom functions for weather info, with event handlers for client connection management.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining functions available to the language model.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools and functions for the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns in conversations for smart turn detection.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer using Silero models.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context for the language model including messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pair of aggregators for user and assistant in LLM context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Runs the pipeline with handling for signals.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data via callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with given transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
